Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
Against the order impugned imposing penalty under the provisions of Food Safety & Standards Act,
2006 petitioner has the remedy of preferring an appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety &
Standards Act, 2006.
Since such remedy has not been availed, we decline to entertain the present writ petition.

It is, however, provided that if such an appeal is filed within two weeks from today, the same shall be entertained on merits, without raising any objection with regard to limitation and shall be dealt Govind Gihar vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 2 Others on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148631299/
1 with, expeditiously.
